The '''Synthlimb blaster''' was a model of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] weapon implant produced by [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam Medtech]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The enhancement cost 4000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Synthlimb blaster was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]] and written by [[Sterling Hershey]].
